fact: PAPSS announces that cross-border payments in local currencies are now available through United Bank for Africa Uganda.
COMESA, with EU funding, is supporting deployment of its Digital Retail Payment Platform across eight pilot countries including Uganda, with an implementation plan still to be drawn up.
Uganda takes part in the East African Payment System, with inflows of UGX 1.3 trillion in FY2024/25, 99% in Kenyan and Tanzanian currency.
